body:

```
Build type: RelWithDebInfo

```

## Release notes

- [Changelog](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/d714648b8e7c476b7b5c1f661aa192b179bfc1d3) (fixes + features)
- [News](./runtime/doc/news.txt) (`:help news` in Nvim)

## Install

### Windows

#### Zip

1. Download **nvim-win64.zip** (or **nvim-win-arm64.zip** for ARM)
2. Extract the zip
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

#### MSI

1. Download **nvim-win64.msi** (or **nvim-win-arm64.msi** for ARM)
2. Run the MSI
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to [install `vcruntime*.dll`](https://neovim.io/doc/install/#windows).

### macOS (x86_64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### macOS (arm64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) [builds for older glibc](https://github.com/neovim/neovim-releases).

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (arm64)

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Other

- Install by [package manager](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/master/INSTALL.md#install-from-package)

name: Hermes Agent v0.22.4
body:
# Hermes Agent v0.22.4

**Release Date:** October 21, 2026

> Patch release. Desktop stops showing suggestion pills above the composer, plus small plugin and dashboard fixes, for the CLI and installer, the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

## Fixes

- **Desktop no longer shows suggestion pills above the composer.** The pills appeared for no clear reason, mostly nudging you to set up MCP servers. They and the helpers that only they used are gone. ([#142559](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142559))
- **Plugins that install nothing skip the dependency consent step.** A plugin that declares no dependencies, or whose `pyproject.toml` installs nothing, now enables without an empty consent prompt. ([#142569](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142569))
- **Dashboard: WhatsApp can be safely re-paired after logging out.** ([#142439](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142439))
- **Desktop plugin review:** the surface lint no longer flags prototype writes; reviewers check them by hand. ([#142586](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142586))
- **Desktop: the approval-mode chip follows the active profile's mode.** ([#142565](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142565))
- **Release builds:** the desktop bundle's pre-build check gets enough time to verify archived build inputs when storage is slow. ([#142623](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142623))

Also new in the plugin catalog: bubblewrap (bwrap terminal backend on Linux), Singularity/Apptainer, mcp-serve (Hermes as an MCP server), agent-importers (`hermes import-agent`, now with Cursor), inbox and workflow-record from Hermes Labs. Telegram Business moves to the Hermes Labs community tier.

## About this release

Measured at commit `4d04303818b`, the window since v0.22.3 contains **14 non-merge commits** across **82 changed files** (+1,475 / −3,022) and **13 merged PRs**.

## Updating

- Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.
- Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.
- CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.
- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Full Changelog**: [v0.22.3...v0.22.4](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/compare/v0.22.3...v0.22.4)

name: v0.8.185
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.185

Released on 2026-10-21.

`hyperframes cloud render --resolution 4k` now works for transparent MOV and WebM. A render no longer fails when its audio peak stalls under correction, `check` accepts projects that inline the GSAP library, and cloud render chunks start their capture browsers while video frames extract. Capture motion blur arrives as an opt-in on the composition root.

## Features

- **CLI:** `cloud render --resolution 4k` accepts `--format mov` and `--format webm`; the CLI and the render server no longer refuse 4K with a transparent format ([25126bca6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/25126bca6ced6cb8c839213430cde51e48261b7c), [#6045](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6045)).
- **Core:** Capture motion blur: `data-motion-blur` on the composition root blurs fast-moving elements across sub-frame samples, with shutter angle and sample count settings ([0f1d6908f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0f1d6908fdfb4dc7b9ac21520b7e9e268c87aacc), [#5967](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5967)); it follows the render's device scale, so 2x and 4K renders blur at full resolution ([ffcef8f88](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ffcef8f886b4a1ed9dba12f21b9939db5c17746e), [#5968](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5968)).

## Fixes

- **Producer:** A render whose AAC true peak stalls above the limit during correction no longer fails at assemble ([32ebdde61](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/32ebdde61266c0858a193855436be5c703a6171a), [#6043](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6043)).
- **Lint:** `check` no longer fails a project that pastes the GSAP library inline, and a bundle around GSAP never inherits its exemption ([50e7e8df6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/50e7e8df69e8e29eb897ef25f310de92949e6062), [#6018](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6018)).
- **Engine:** A capture browser whose BeginFrame probe passed keeps BeginFrame capture when closing the probe page is slow ([a8b576d15](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a8b576d156109a3fdd519cb7b14aead6cfd2118e), [#6037](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6037)).

## Performance

- **Producer:** A cloud render chunk starts its capture browsers while its video frames are still being extracted, so heavy chunks finish sooner and cost less ([0716670fa](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0716670faf6803d9b8a0c3d2d92e62f45759ee07), [#6031](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6031)).

## Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.8.184...v0.8.185

name: v0.8.184
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.184

Released on 2026-10-21.

`hyperframes cloud render` now takes projects whose media is far larger than the project upload limit. Multi-worker mp4 renders start encoding while they capture, Lambda chunks run more capture browsers at once, and a heavy project's preview builds faster. Transparent webm keeps its transparency in Studio previews, and a color grade applies to an image that appears after its scene starts hidden.

## Features

- **CLI:** `cloud render` uploads media of 5 MB or more as hosted assets before zipping the project, so projects with media far larger than the upload limit render with no manual step. Uploads are cached, so a re-render sends only new or changed media ([b306438e8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b306438e8b5e2199db1ed07e6eb4332d53131048), [#5931](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5931)).

## Fixes

- **Studio Server:** A transparent VP8 or VP9 webm, such as `remove-background` output, keeps its transparency in the preview copy that `check`, Studio and publish make ([d67e81c7f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d67e81c7f1a804bec337463bfa7b6f46f278b25d), [#6025](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6025)).
- **Core:** A color-graded image renders graded in `snapshot` and `render` when it is hidden as its scene starts and revealed later ([087451837](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/087451837b16cb9ae74f7932a4a18af86e3a012d), [#6012](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6012)).
- **CLI:** A `preview` refused inside a host app no longer stops other Chrome processes left behind by earlier runs ([5641a9179](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5641a9179acd821dfa3a6a69725beb31de6b7a5b), [#6022](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6022)).

## Performance

- **Producer:** A multi-worker mp4 render starts encoding while its frames are still being captured, instead of after, with byte-identical output ([eec3c51d7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/eec3c51d7509365c388b4a962a7156cbb52ae62a), [#5952](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5952)).
- **AWS Lambda:** Each chunk renders with as many capture browsers as the function can host, five instead of three on a 10 GB function, so heavy 4K chunks finish sooner ([cde21630e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cde21630e46dc9540b42876d0de3738d4b6bf5c2), [#6026](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6026)).
- **Core:** A heavy project's first preview page builds sooner, without rescanning its styles once per composition variable ([0d51eb0de](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0d51eb0de46b2179acf982d5cc7d0a17e9316ee8), [#5893](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5893)).
- **Core:** A page build reads fonts, inlined assets and scenes mounted many times only once, and an offline build with a warm font cache makes no network request ([884d8690a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/884d8690af6906ddffe971e15bd5a1b24921e13b), [#5954](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5954)).

## Internal

- **Core:** The building blocks of capture motion blur (element poses, finding fast movers, the per-frame draw). Nothing uses them yet ([8df2d8d95](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8df2d8d95decbab22454c632e86b41c2cde4386b), [#5875](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5875)).
- **CLI:** The capture network tests no longer flake on CI ([cfdddd8a9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cfdddd8a90d1c0247a491ebb37cff7a51595fd28), [#6024](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6024)).
- A hung Windows test run keeps its log, and commit hooks lint .mjs and .cjs files ([2e1cf69e0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2e1cf69e0700194976570a6445118dc64a1fab7e), [#6023](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6023)).

## Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.8.183...v0.8.184

name: v18.12.6
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added the `prompt-cache-persistent` catalog axis (`isPromptCachePersistent`) for providers whose own endpoint never expires prompt caches; logged-in OpenAI Codex declares it

### Changed

- Updated the bundled Yolo-Auto catalog to its current models, `qwen3.8-27b` (now the default), `yolo`, `yolo-small`, and `yolo-128k`, and removed the retired `deepseek-flash-v4` and `qwen3.8-flash`

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Added the `_session/steering` ACP extension (advertised as `_meta.steering.supported`), so clients such as agent-shell can steer a running turn; a steer sent while a permission dialog is open cancels that dialog, and `_meta.steering.queue: "followUp"` queues a follow-up instead ([#15885](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15885) by [@marcintustin](https://github.com/marcintustin))
- `/mcp reauth <name>` now works over ACP, RPC, and print mode (`omp -p '/mcp reauth <name>'`): it opens the browser, prints the authorization URL, reconnects the server in the running session, and print mode exits 1 when reauthorization fails ([#16046](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16046) by [@marcintustin](https://github.com/marcintustin))

### Changed

- ACP `session/cancel` now also cancels prompts that are queued or still dispatching, and stops autonomous runs, instead of being ignored when no client turn is streaming ([#15885](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15885) by [@marcintustin](https://github.com/marcintustin))
- Idle compaction no longer runs on logged-in OpenAI Codex accounts, whose prompt cache never expires; compacting while idle only threw away a warm cache
- ACP sessions no longer fail to start when a client-declared MCP server cannot connect; the failure is reported in the session, and an HTTP/SSE server can be repaired with `/mcp reauth` ([#16046](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16046) by [@marcintustin](https://github.com/marcintustin))
- `/mcp reauth`, `/mcp test`, and `/mcp unauth` now pick the project entry when a server is defined in both project and user config, and skip project config when `mcp.enableProjectConfig` is off ([#16046](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16046) by [@marcintustin](https://github.com/marcintustin))
- `/mcp reauth` removes the server's stale `Authorization` header from its config when it writes the new OAuth binding ([#16046](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16046) by [@marcintustin](https://github.com/marcintustin))
- `omp -p '/compact'`, `/handoff`, and `/retry` given as CLI arguments now run the command instead of sending the text to the model, and exit 1 when the command fails; slash text arriving on stdin or from `@file` is still sent to the model ([#16387](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16387) by [@marcintustin](https://github.com/marcintustin))
- Interactive startup no longer waits for extensions that register only tools, commands, flags, renderers, or event hooks (for example MCP bridge plugins): they load once the composer accepts input, and your first message waits for them instead. An extension is deferred only after one launch has confirmed it registers no providers, shortcuts, composer shapes, or file fallbacks. Launches that resume a session, pass `--tools`, or pass flags omp does not recognize still load every extension first ([#16684](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16684) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

### Fixed

- Fixed subagents whose role has an explicitly empty fallback chain falling back through the `default` chain when the default role uses the same model, including after a retry fallback, prewalk or context promotion briefly switched models or the subagent was revived ([#16548](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16548) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- Fixed `/usage` and `omp usage --json` listing identity-less OAuth accounts such as Devin as missing usage beside their working reports ([#16549](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16549) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- Fixed releasing or reaping a browser tab returning while Chromium still listed the page; the close now waits until Chromium reports the tab destroyed ([#16680](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16680) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed the advisor prompt forbidding all repeated advice, including real escalations: advisors may now re-raise a prior nit or concern as a blocker once new evidence makes it one ([#13887](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/13887), [#16484](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16484) by [@pjh890321](https://github.com/pjh890321))
- Fixed Esc no longer interrupting in the TUI after a second MCP OAuth login replaced an unfinished first one ([#16046](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16046) by [@marcintustin](https://github.com/marcintustin))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Changed

- In Tern, centered sheets (`/context`, reports, keyboard shortcuts, BTW history, session info, the pause screen) fill the pane when it is narrower than 100 columns instead of floating with margins ([#16676](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16676) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

### Fixed

- Fixed the `/agents` and `/models` hubs in Tern squeezing the left sidebar as long lines (such as a streaming new-agent draft) widen the body pane

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Added

- Added `RpcConnection.requestCancellable()` and `Client.requestPermission(params, { signal })`; client connections abort a handler and answer `-32800` when the peer sends `$/cancel_request`, while agent connections keep running the request and return its real result ([#15885](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15885) by [@marcintustin](https://github.com/marcintustin))


## What's Changed
* fix(coding-agent): clarify blocker escalation in advisor prompt by @pjh890321 in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16484
* feat(coding-agent): support ACP _session/steering for mid-turn client steering by @marcintustin in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15885
* feat(acp): support /mcp reauth outside the TUI by @marcintustin in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16046
* feat(tui): fill narrow Tern panes with centered sheets and pickers by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16676
* fix(coding-agent): confirm browser tab close and repair red CI tests by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16680
* perf(coding-agent): load startup-safe extensions after the composer accepts input by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16684
* fix(coding-agent): keep explicitly empty subagent fallback chains empty by @eggpeat in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16548
* fix(coding-agent): stop listing identity-less OAuth accounts as missing usage by @eggpeat in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16549

name: v1.4.0
body:
### New Features

- **Image input for classifiers**: codemode `models.classify()` accepts `images` for TypeSafe's Jev and Cloudflare's Clef models on `typesafe`, `cloudflare-workers-ai`, and OpenRouter. See [Use classifier models](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.4.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/models.md#use-classifier-models) and [Codemode](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.4.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/codemode.md#models).
- **Models Configuration reference**: every provider, model, model override, and compatibility field of `models.json`, generated from its schema. See [Models Configuration](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.4.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/models-configuration.md).
- **Summaries without a fixed output cap**: compaction and branch summaries use the model's output limit, so long reasoning no longer makes them fail. See [Compaction](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.4.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/compaction.md#compaction).
- **Codemode waits for a free worker**: parallel scripts and in-process subagents queue instead of failing, and `PI_CODEMODE_MAX_WORKERS` raises the limit. See [Codemode limits](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.4.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/codemode.md#limits).
- **Rex terminal support**: OSC 8 hyperlinks, truecolor, and inline images.

### Added

- Added a Models Configuration reference generated from the `models.json` schema, listing all provider, model, model override, and compatibility fields ([#10790](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10790))
- Codemode `models.classify()` now accepts `images` for TypeSafe's Jev and Cloudflare's Clef models on `typesafe`, `cloudflare-workers-ai`, and OpenRouter, and lists Clef Omni and Jev 1.14 on Workers AI.
- Provider-level `compat` in `models.json` now also applies to classifier models, with the System One fields `imageInput` and `sendImageOptInHeader` for proxies that serve another service's classifiers. Extension classifier models accept `compat` too.
- Added `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` to the `minimax` and `minimax-cn` providers, with thinking levels low through max ([#11121](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11121))
- Added support for the Rex terminal: OSC 8 hyperlinks, truecolor, and inline images ([#11131](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11131), [#11150](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11150) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll), [#11183](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11183) by [@nihaals](https://github.com/nihaals))

### Changed

- Provider attribution headers now come from pi-ai's client identity. Extensions' `before_provider_headers` handlers no longer see the OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM, and OpenCode attribution headers; returning `null` for one still removes it. Cloudflare requests send pi's detailed `User-Agent` instead of `pi-coding-agent`, as do GitHub release checks for tool downloads, and OpenCode requests send `x-opencode-client` whenever attribution is enabled, not only with a session.
- `generateSummary()` and `generateSummaryWithUsage()` now ignore their `reserveTokens` parameter. Summary requests use the model's output limit instead.
- Changed the default GitHub Copilot model from `gpt-5.4`, which Copilot retired, to `gpt-6.1-sol`.
- Changed the default NVIDIA model to `nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b` ([#10910](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/10910) by [@cv](https://github.com/cv))
- Changed the default Xiaomi model to `mimo-v2.6-pro` for the `xiaomi` and Xiaomi Token Plan providers, since `mimo-v2.5-pro` left the catalog.
- Grok 4.3 and Grok 4.5 on the `xai` provider now offer the `xhigh` thinking level.
- Sign in with ChatGPT: ChatGPT Business workspace usage-limit errors are not retried and tell the user to ask their workspace admin to increase the limit.

### Fixed

- Fixed compaction and branch summaries failing with "generation hit the token cap" when reasoning used most of the fixed summary output limit. Summaries now use the model's output limit, and `compaction.reserveTokens` only controls when compaction starts ([#9512](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9512), [#9075](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9075)).
- Fixed `models.schema.json` missing descriptions for provider and model fields, so editors showed no hints for them ([#10790](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10790))
- Fixed `pi update` failing with "Managed install marker is missing or invalid" when `managed-install.json` starts with a UTF-8 BOM, which Windows PowerShell 5.1 adds when it rewrites the file.
- Fixed HTML export showing literal asterisks for Markdown bold and italic next to CJK punctuation ([#3353](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/3353), [#10154](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10154))
- Fixed the terminal staying in mouse-tracking, focus-reporting, Kitty keyboard, and alternate-screen modes when pi exits without its normal terminal teardown, which flooded the shell prompt with escape sequences ([#11170](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11170))
- Fixed concurrent extension `select`/`confirm`/`input`/`editor` dialogs and inline `custom()` components in interactive mode: a second dialog replaced the first and the first promise never settled; closing the visible dialog now shows the previous one again ([#11166](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11166), [#9909](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9909))
- Fixed pasting in the shell hanging after copying text in pi and suspending it with Ctrl+Z on Linux: the background `wl-copy`/`xclip`/`xsel` process that keeps serving the clipboard was suspended along with pi ([#11179](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11179))
- Fixed codemode scripts failing immediately when both codemode workers are busy, for example with parallel codemode calls or in-process subagents. Scripts now wait up to 60 seconds for a free worker, and `PI_CODEMODE_MAX_WORKERS` raises the limit of two workers ([#11184](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11184))
- Fixed extensions failing to load when importing `@earendil-works/pi-ai/models` (e.g. for `clampThinkingLevel`) by exposing the subpath through the extension loader aliases and virtual modules ([#11156](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11156))
- Fixed `mcp.json` files that start with a UTF-8 BOM failing to parse, which skipped all their MCP servers and made `pi mcp add`/`pi mcp remove` fail ([#11191](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11191))
- Fixed `/compact <instructions>` ignoring the instructions when summarizing the start of a turn that compaction splits. When the split turn was the only new content since the last compaction, the instructions were ignored entirely ([#11058](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11058))
- Fixed resumed sessions and `/tree` navigation leaving extension tools inactive when the branch recorded its tools before they were registered, such as tools from extensions installed after the session started. Extension tools the branch never added or removed are now active unless they are registered with `defaultActive: false` ([#11062](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11062), [#11075](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11075))
- Fixed sessions breaking after recovery from a response cut off at the output limit: the truncated tool call was omitted but its tool results were kept, so providers rejected every later request ([#11227](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11227), [#11233](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11233) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll))
- Fixed the `grep` tool following `RIPGREP_CONFIG_PATH`, where options such as `--fixed-strings` silently changed regex searches into literal ones. The tool now runs `rg --no-config` ([#11203](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11203), [#11230](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11230) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll))
- Fixed Windows shell detection rejecting runnable Microsoft Store shell aliases ([#9504](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/9504) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll))
- Fixed Windows shell detection missing PowerShell outside `PATH` and the legacy WSL `bash.exe` launcher when Windows is not installed in `C:\Windows`. pi now checks `%ProgramFiles%\PowerShell\7`, `%SystemRoot%\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0`, and `%SystemRoot%` ([#9501](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/9501) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll))
- Fixed GitHub Copilot sessions with large request bodies, such as many images, failing with HTTP 413 `failed to parse request` instead of compacting and retrying ([#11016](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11016) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll))
- Fixed the `openai-codex` provider offering `gpt-5.5` and `gpt-5.3-codex-spark`, which always fail for ChatGPT accounts ([#11173](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11173) by [@lucasmeijer](https://github.com/lucasmeijer))
- Fixed whitespace-only tool output (for example a bare `\r\n` from bash) making OpenAI Completions, OpenAI Responses, and Google requests fail with a 400 ([#8720](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/8720))
- Fixed automatic retry not triggering for more gateway upstream failures, `stream disconnected before completion` errors relayed by Codex CLI proxies, and transient Google Vertex OAuth token refresh failures, and retrying errors because of digits inside request ids or byte counts ([#10920](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10920), [#11057](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11057), [#10996](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10996))
- Fixed OpenAI Responses models losing the prompt cache on every deferred tool load after a tool was removed ([#10940](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10940))
- Fixed Cloudflare Workers AI classifier pricing: Clef Flash costs $0.038 and Jev $0.042 per million input tokens instead of Jev being listed as free.
- Fixed an unclosed `$$` display-math block swallowing or corrupting every Markdown table after it ([#11159](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11159))
- Fixed Markdown bold and italic not rendering next to CJK punctuation ([#10730](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/10730) by [@theBucky](https://github.com/theBucky))
- Fixed `@` file autocomplete returning no results for queries containing regex metacharacters such as `[` or `(` ([#10972](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10972))

name: Reasonix Studio v2.48.0
body:
本版大幅降低长会话和大型工作区的页面内存占用，预设模块选择支持多选，并修好记忆多进程写入互相覆盖等问题。

## 新增

- 预设模块选择支持多选、搜索、全选与内置／自定义分组，手动输入 ID 移到高级选项。关联 #13988。

## 变更

- 旧会话先显示列表，摘要与轮数在后台补全；读取未完成或失败会明确提示，后台索引会为打开会话让出资源。关联 #14086 by @SivanCola。

## 修复

- 长会话里已完成且收起的工具调用卡片不再挂载整段输出，页面节点数和内存占用大幅下降。关联 #13899。
- 工作区有几万个未提交文件时，“改动”列表只渲染一页，其余显示“还有 N 项没有显示”，可按 500 项展开。关联 #13899。
- 两个进程共用一个记忆目录时，写入不再互相覆盖，也不再出现两条生效事实、改名没存下来、回滚倒退版本或索引丢行。关联 #14100 by @chuiwenwei。
- 回滚到旧版本的记忆时，不再返回该版本从未有过的内容或报“找不到该版本”。关联 #14096 by @chuiwenwei。
- 会话历史搜索不再把宿主追加的记忆召回和执行策略块当作用户说过的话。关联 #14076 by @chuiwenwei。
- 读取 JSONL 检查点时不再跟随指向所指定会话目录之外的文件符号链接。关联 #14086 by @SivanCola。
- 恢复把右侧工作区文件树里的文件和文件夹拖入对话，作为文件引用添加。关联 #12771 fixed in #12877。
- 普通会话启动期间读取 MCP 资源时，会等待已授权的服务器连接就绪，不再因连接未完成而提前报错。关联 #14084 by @SivanCola。
- 已登录账号时，反馈贡献榜不再错误地提示先去设置里登录。关联 #14012 fixed in #14071 by @lancy69。
- `reasonix config compact-ratio 33.3` 现在写入 `0.333`，不再写成 `0.33299999999999996`。关联 #14120。
- `reasonix session` 和 `reasonix task` 的 `--dir` 指向不存在的路径或文件时，报参数错误并退出码 2，不再返回空结果。关联 #14119。
- 窗口比项目右键菜单矮时，菜单底部的操作不再被切掉，菜单限制在窗口内并可滚动。关联 #14128、#14129。

## 升级须知

- 升级后首次打开会重建一次历史索引，首次打开会慢一些。关联 #14076 by @chuiwenwei。
- 另一个进程正持有记忆目录的锁时，写入可能等约 2 秒后返回可重试的“被另一个进程锁定”，而不是悄悄写坏。关联 #14100 by @chuiwenwei。

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@SivanCola、@chuiwenwei、@lancy69

---

<!-- lang:en -->

This release cuts page memory in long sessions and large workspaces, adds multi-select for preset modules, and fixes memory writes overwriting each other across processes.

## New

- Preset module selection supports multi-select, search, select all and built-in/custom groups; manual ID entry moves to advanced. Refs #13988.

## Changed

- Legacy chats appear before summaries finish, which fill in the background; pending or failed reads are shown, and background indexing yields to opening a chat. Refs #14086 by @SivanCola.

## Fixed

- A finished, closed tool-call card no longer mounts its whole output, which cuts DOM nodes and memory in long sessions. Refs #13899.
- With tens of thousands of changed files the Changes list draws one page and says how many it left out, opening 500 at a time. Refs #13899.
- With two processes sharing one memory directory, writes no longer overwrite each other, duplicate an active subject, lose a rename, roll a revision back or drop an index line. Refs #14100 by @chuiwenwei.
- Restoring an old memory revision no longer returns a body that revision never had or reports it missing. Refs #14096 by @chuiwenwei.
- History search no longer treats host-appended memory-recall and execution-policy blocks as words the user said. Refs #14076 by @chuiwenwei.
- JSONL checkpoint reads no longer follow file symlinks that point outside the supplied session directory. Refs #14086 by @SivanCola.
- Dragging files and folders from the workbench file tree into chat as file references works again. Refs #12771 fixed in #12877.
- Ordinary sessions wait for the authorized MCP server connection when reading resources at startup instead of failing early. Refs #14084 by @SivanCola.
- The feedback contribution board no longer asks signed-in users to log in through Settings. Refs #14012 fixed in #14071 by @lancy69.
- `reasonix config compact-ratio 33.3` saves `0.333` instead of `0.33299999999999996`. Refs #14120.
- `reasonix session` and `reasonix task` fail with an argument error (exit 2) for a `--dir` that does not exist or is a file, instead of an empty result. Refs #14119.
- When the window is shorter than a project's right-click menu, the actions at the bottom are no longer cut off; the menu stays inside the window and scrolls. Refs #14128, #14129.

## Upgrade notes

- The history index rebuilds once on first open after upgrading, so the first open is slower. Refs #14076 by @chuiwenwei.
- While another process holds the memory directory lock, a write may wait about 2 seconds and then return a retryable "locked by another process" error instead of silently corrupting it. Refs #14100 by @chuiwenwei.

## Contributors

Thanks to this release's contributors: @SivanCola, @chuiwenwei, @lancy69

## What's Changed
* fix(tools): normalize redundant argument envelopes / 兼容多余工具参数包装 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14013
* fix(guardian): roll the transcript cursor back with the review by @imcreazy in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14046
* fix(studio): prevent settings search result overlap by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14062
* fix(tui): offer /quit in the slash completion menu by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14060
* fix(mcp): keep add argument errors readable by @pei711 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14068
* fix(mcp): import cc-switch servers without sqlite3 by @pei711 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14069
* fix(serve): expose account state to the feedback board by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14071
* fix(history): strip the host-appended blocks from what the user said by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14076
* fix(startup): wait for MCP readiness and isolate tests / 修复启动等待与测试隔离 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14084
* fix(agent): a degraded fold lists what the user said, not the host's blocks by @xxoingr in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14090
* fix(studio): restore workspace file drag into chat / 恢复工作区文件拖入对话 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14082
* fix(agent): exempt from the origin check only what the person typed by @xxoingr in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14091
* test(sessionstore): observe the 1.x listing replay instead of timing it by @xxoingr in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14097
* fix(history): progressive legacy discovery and background scheduling / 旧会话渐进加载与后台调度 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14086
* fix(memory): a revision snapshot must hold the revision it names by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14096
* fix(memory): serialise store mutations across processes with one file lock per directory by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14100
* test(memory): reconcile the cross-process test helpers of the snapshot and lock changes by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14103
* feat(studio): grouped preset module multiselect / 预设模块分组多选 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14064
* fix(config): a price source refuses invisible format characters by @xxoingr in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14107
* docs(guide): the Chinese guide describes WSL machines and the agent-shell refusal by @xxoingr in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14109
* docs(guide): the terminal key tables match the /mcp panel and the keys 2.x has by @xxoingr in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14111
* fix(desktop): do not mount the body of a finished, closed tool card by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14117
* fix(cli): save the compact ratio as the decimal the user typed by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14121
* fix(cli): refuse a machine --dir that is not a directory by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14123
* fix(studio): name a property the sheets define by @imcreazy in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14047
* fix(desktop): draw a page of the changes list, not every row by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14124
* fix(desktop): keep a project's context menu inside a short window by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14128
* docs(release): studio 2.48.0 notes by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14130

## New Contributors
* @pei711 made their first contribution in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14068

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.47.1...studio-v2.48.0


---

**macOS** 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。**Windows** 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。**Linux** Debian 系从 `.deb` 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 `.rpm` 安装（`sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm`）。x86_64 用文件名带 amd64 的包，aarch64（统信 UOS、麒麟等）用带 arm64 的包。也提供 `.AppImage`（只提供下载，不会自更新；需要 FUSE 2，或用 `--appimage-extract-and-run` 启动）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 `.deb` 走自己的包（`.rpm` 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

name: Open Design 0.26.1 — Intelligent Router
body:
## English

Meet Skill Discovery: describe what you want to create, and Open Design finds the relevant Skills to guide the work—from your first idea to the next revision.

Your idea should be the starting point. In 0.26.1, **Skill Discovery helps Open Design understand the kind of work you want to make and choose the Skills that fit.** You can focus on the result, with less manual setup before creating and more continuity as you refine it. Alongside this, smoother project starts, connected feedback, and steadier previews keep your work moving.

## 📥 Download / 下载

| Platform / 平台 | Installer / 安装包 |
|---|---|
| macOS Apple silicon | [Download](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/releases/download/open-design-v0.26.1/open-design-0.26.1-mac-arm64.dmg) · [SHA-256](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/releases/download/open-design-v0.26.1/open-design-0.26.1-mac-arm64.dmg.sha256) |
| macOS Intel | [Download](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/releases/download/open-design-v0.26.1/open-design-0.26.1-mac-x64.dmg) · [SHA-256](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/releases/download/open-design-v0.26.1/open-design-0.26.1-mac-x64.dmg.sha256) |
| Windows x64 | [Download](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/releases/download/open-design-v0.26.1/open-design-0.26.1-win-x64-setup.exe) · [SHA-256](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/releases/download/open-design-v0.26.1/open-design-0.26.1-win-x64-setup.exe.sha256) |

## 🧠 Skill Discovery: the right Skills for what you have in mind

Describe the result you want. **Skill Discovery selects the deliverable type and reads its native Skill guidance**, giving Open Design a task-specific starting point. It supports eleven deliverable types, including interactive prototypes and motion work. (#8804)

- **Start with your intent.** Your explicit request takes priority when it conflicts with a selected task type. Skills and templates you mention provide compatible guidance and references while keeping the requested deliverable in focus.
- **Bring the right guidance into the work.** Open Design reads the relevant Skill instructions for the chosen type, so you spend less time finding and selecting them yourself.
- **Keep the direction as you iterate.** Follow-up work carries the chosen Skill guidance forward, keeping revisions consistent. If you ask only for a plan or clarification, that request does not silently become permission to produce the final work.

## 🔥 Highlights

- 🔗 **Share the work, not a pile of screenshots.** Publish a design file as one public link, stop it when the review is over, and resume the same link later. Comments left on the shared page flow back to the file, with unread feedback waiting where you work. (#8408, #8859, #8867, #8904) Thanks @alchemistklk.
- 🤖 **Bring your own connection — and keep the Agent in the loop.** Open Design can use available registered runtimes, and the same BYOK connection works from the app or the `od` CLI. Your project preview stays isolated to its own work, even when two projects use the same browser storage. (#8702) Thanks @itscheems.
- 🚪 **Home now opens straight into the real project.** Send an idea from Home and the project is already there: one steady workspace, one Working state, and no disappearing first message while creation or uploads catch up. (#8267) Thanks @Siri-Ray.
- 🎬 **Motion keeps its rhythm.** Video-motion previews stop jumping through music when the browser hiccups; while a video is still being made, you can watch the picture without unexpected sound, then hear the finished result normally. (#8777) Thanks to the Open Design crew.

## ✨ Added

### 🎨 Studio, prototypes and media

- **Use your organisation's image sources without a key hunt.** Open Design can use configured company stock sources while retaining source information and keeping credits out of the finished page unless you ask for them. (#8691)
- **Chinese community help now leads to Feishu.** Simplified and Traditional Chinese entry points point to the official Feishu community, while other locales continue to use Discord. (#8884) Thanks @joeylee12629-star.

### 🧠 Agents, workspaces and CLI

- **Your MCP tools follow the workspace you selected.** Switch workspaces, reconnect, and the bridge now sees the projects and artifacts you actually have open. (#7619) Thanks @roian6.

## ⚡ Performance

- **Spend less time waiting for a Motion export.** Desktop video capture is faster while preserving the requested frame size, frame rate, and image quality. (#8798) Thanks @PerishCode.

## 🐛 Fixed

### 🧩 Home and projects

- **Task choices and the More menu feel like Home again.** The task-type controls, cancellation behaviour, compact-window layout, and keyboard navigation are back where your draft can rely on them. (#8947)
- **Artifact actions stay visible in chat.** Project conversations keep the familiar action styling for generated artifacts, and Home no longer surfaces the obsolete plugin hover card. (#8978, #8911) Thanks @alchemistklk.
- **Finished work stays finished.** A brief history lookup failure no longer turns an existing delivered run into a failure when you reopen the project. (#8804)

### 🎞️ Preview and sharing

- **Keep commenting while the preview changes.** A saved artifact can refresh with a comment draft open; a missing target asks for reselection instead of throwing the draft away. (#8904) Thanks @alchemistklk.
- **An existing shared file keeps its identity.** If local share bookkeeping is missing, Open Design recovers a verified cloud file and its original link rather than silently minting a replacement. (#8859, #8867) Thanks @alchemistklk.

## 🙏 Thanks to everyone who shipped 0.26.1

@alchemistklk · @itscheems · @roian6 · @Siri-Ray · @PerishCode · @joeylee12629-star

---

## 中文

全新 Skill Discovery，从你的创作意图出发，发现并选用合适的 Skill。少一些手动配置，从第一个想法到下一轮修改，让创作更贴近你想要的结果。

说出你想做什么，让 Open Design 更懂得如何开始。0.26.1 带来 **Skill Discovery：理解你想创作的作品类型，选择对应 Skill，并在后续修改中延续创作方向。**从开始创作前的能力选择，到作品生成后的继续打磨，你可以把更多注意力留给想法本身。更顺畅的项目启动、分享反馈和预览体验，也让整个创作过程更加连贯。

📥 [下载正式版安装包](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/releases/tag/open-design-v0.26.1#assets)

## 🧠 Skill Discovery：更懂你的想法，也更懂该用什么能力

描述你想要的结果，**Skill Discovery 会识别作品类型，选择并读取对应的原生 Skill 指引**，让 Open Design 带着适合这类任务的方法开始创作。目前覆盖 11 类交付物，包括交互原型、动效等创作场景。 (#8804)

- **从你的意图出发。** 当明确需求与手动选择的任务类型不一致时，优先尊重你说出的需求；你提到的 Skill 和模板会作为相容的指导与参考，让创作围绕你真正想要的作品展开。
- **让合适的能力参与创作。** 根据作品类型读取对应 Skill 的具体指引，减少你在开始前查找、选择技能的操作。
- **继续修改，延续创作方向。** 继续修改时，沿用已选 Skill 的创作指导，保持前后连贯。你只想讨论方案或澄清需求时，也会尊重这个阶段的意图，不擅自开始制作。

## 🔥 重点更新

- 🔗 **分享作品，而不是一堆截图。** 把设计文件发布为一个公开链接；评审结束时停止分享，需要继续时仍沿用同一个链接。公开页面上的评论会同步回文件，未读反馈就在你工作的地方等你处理。 (#8408、#8859、#8867、#8904) 感谢 @alchemistklk。
- 🤖 **带上自己的连接，把 Agent 留在流程里。** Open Design 可以使用已注册且可用的运行时；同一套 BYOK 连接既能在应用中使用，也能通过 `od` CLI 使用。即使两个项目用了相同的浏览器存储键，预览状态也各自独立。 (#8702) 感谢 @itscheems。
- 🚪 **从 Home 发送，直接进入真实项目。** 从 Home 发出想法后，项目工作区立即就位：只有一个稳定的界面、一个 Working 状态；创建或上传较慢时，第一条消息也不会消失。 (#8267) 感谢 @Siri-Ray。
- 🎬 **动效预览终于跟得上节奏。** 浏览器短暂卡顿时，视频动效不会反复跳音；生成期间可以看画面而不会意外出声，完成后仍可正常听到成片声音。 (#8777) 感谢 Open Design 团队。

## ✨ 新增

### 🎨 工作台、原型与素材

- **使用团队素材库，不必再找 Key。** Open Design 可以使用已配置的公司素材来源，保留来源信息；除非你明确要求，成品页面不会出现署名。 (#8691)
- **中文社区入口现在前往飞书。** 简体中文和繁体中文的入口会打开官方飞书社区，其他语言继续使用 Discord。 (#8884) 感谢 @joeylee12629-star。

### 🧠 Agent、工作区与 CLI

- **MCP 会跟随你正在使用的工作区。** 切换工作区并重新连接后，工具看到的是当前项目和产物，不再误落到其他工作区。 (#7619) 感谢 @roian6。

## ⚡ 性能

- **少等一会儿动效导出。** 桌面端视频抓帧更快，同时保持请求的分辨率、帧率和画面质量。 (#8798) 感谢 @PerishCode。

## 🐛 修复

### 🧩 Home 与项目

- **任务选择和“更多”菜单重新可靠。** 任务类型控件、取消选择、短窗口布局和键盘导航都回到能放心保留草稿的位置。 (#8947)
- **对话中的作品操作重新清晰可见。** 生成作品的操作样式恢复熟悉的样子，Home 也不再显示过时的插件悬浮卡。 (#8978、#8911) 感谢 @alchemistklk。
- **已完成的工作仍然是已完成。** 重新打开项目时，即使历史状态短暂无法读取，已有交付物也不会被错误显示为失败。 (#8804)

### 🎞️ 预览与分享

- **预览变化时，评论可以继续写。** 保存作品后，即使评论草稿还开着，预览也会刷新；评论目标消失时会提示重新选择，而不是丢掉草稿。 (#8904) 感谢 @alchemistklk。
- **已有的分享文件保留自己的身份。** 本地分享记录缺失时，Open Design 会恢复已验证的云端文件与原链接，而不会悄悄新建替代链接。 (#8859、#8867) 感谢 @alchemistklk。

## 🙏 感谢参与 0.26.1 的贡献者

@alchemistklk · @itscheems · @roian6 · @Siri-Ray · @PerishCode · @joeylee12629-star

# oh-my-codex v0.21.30

`0.21.30` is a patch release for Team monitor-path dispatch serialization (4 commits, 10 files, +324/−78; PRs #3879, #3880, #3882).

## Highlights

- **Team monitor-path dispatch serialization (#3879, #3880, #3882):** The v0.21.29 release fixed dispatch retry consistency, mailbox wake acknowledgment, and damaged mailbox recovery for the primary dispatch path. This release extends those same fixes to the secondary monitor-path delivery route (`monitorTeam` → `deliverPendingMailboxMessages` → `dispatchPendingMailboxMessage`):
  - **Monitor-path wake serialization (#3879):** Monitor-created wake conditions now participate in the same serialization barrier applied to acknowledgments, ensuring that wake acknowledgment only occurs after all messages from that wake are complete.
  - **Monitor-path acknowledgement race fix (#3880):** Resolves a race condition in the monitor path where mailbox acknowledgements can race with dispatch, leaving messages undelivered. The fix ensures dispatch requests are enqueued inside the serialization barrier with final re-validation.
  - **Stale notification skipping and proof (#3882):** Implements stale monitor notification detection and skipping, with comprehensive test coverage proving the race condition is resolved across both primary and monitor paths.

## Compatibility

- No breaking API changes; all fixes are internal serialization improvements.
- Existing sessions and Team dispatch workflows remain unaffected; recovery is transparent.
- Monitor-based event delivery is now consistent with primary dispatch retry paths.

name: v0.21.29
body:
# oh-my-codex v0.21.29

`0.21.29` is a patch release for Team dispatch state recovery and Codex startup UI protection (1 commit, 16 files, +616/−68; PR #3876).

## Highlights

- **Team dispatch state recovery and startup UI protection (#3876):** This release fixes three related regressions that can occur under dispatch retry and multiple-message scenarios:
  - **Dispatch retry correctness:** A runtime dispatch event can commit before its JSON projection is published. Retrying against an empty, missing, or stale projection can duplicate a request, coalesce into an already delivered request, or leave requests behind during worker retirement. The fix ensures dispatch retries use consistent, durable projections.
  - **Mailbox wake handling:** Multiple mailbox messages can share one wake condition. Acknowledging the wake's original message before other messages are delivered can leave the wake active after the mailbox is fully delivered, preventing further message processing. The fix ensures wake acknowledgment only after all messages from that wake are complete.
  - **Damaged mailbox recovery:** A damaged or unreadable per-worker mailbox was previously treated as empty, allowing a later send to recreate it with inconsistent state. The fix treats damaged mailboxes as undeliverable, preventing silent message loss and worker proliferation.
  - **Codex startup UI safety:** Inbox/notification text can be injected into Codex startup or folder-trust screens, disrupting the initial prompt. The fix prevents notification payload from being rendered during Codex startup and folder-trust UI phases.
  - **Readiness record accuracy:** The Codex startup screen and folder-trust screen are no longer misidentified as a ready prompt, improving diagnostics and state tracking.

## Compatibility

- No breaking API changes; all fixes are internal recovery and UI isolation improvements.
- Existing sessions and dispatch workflows remain unaffected; recovery is transparent.
- Codex startup and folder-trust workflows are now more robust against concurrent notifications.

## Validation

- Pinned candidate `71029cdfc80946da1e0b6770d47e31aae38cf5ab` passed latest-per-name dev CI: 17 checks succeeded and 8 conditional checks were skipped, with no failures (run #39737386059, concluded 07:19Z).

name: v6.7.3
body:
Patch release: Edit Native and native-object fixes that stop a round trip from failing or silently replacing content, plus a readable fallback for native formulas outside PowerPoint.

## Edit Native PPTX

- An explicit Morph pair whose endpoint sits on an otherwise unchanged page no longer crashes with `KeyError`. The page keeps its source bytes, and only the shape name the pair needs is patched (604ecdec).
- Moving an imported object that kept its source text body (for example Office Math that could not be rebuilt as a formula) restores that text body at the new position. Before, any move rebuilt the formulas as plain text. Edits that do change the text still rebuild it, and now warn when native math would become plain text (2e1658cc).
- Imported charts and block formulas rebuilt during a round trip keep their source shape id. Before, export stopped with "Edited slide removed source animation target(s)" (0db9d903, cd445683).

## Native charts and formulas

- A new or rebuilt chart no longer takes the same part name as a chart restored from the source package. Before, the later write silently replaced the earlier chart's data. Exports without such a collision are byte-identical (970d9cc9).
- Native formulas now include a fallback built from their SVG preview, so clients without Office Math support (LibreOffice, WPS) show the formula instead of nothing. PowerPoint keeps using the native math (dc7eab3f).
- PPTX import rebuilds PPT Master formulas whose color is a theme color or translucent, instead of turning them into plain text boxes (029201fe).

## Live preview editor

- The preview canvas no longer stays blank with "SVG may be corrupted or missing the root `<svg>` element", and Save no longer writes `ns0:`-prefixed SVGs. This regression was only on `main` after v6.7.2. Thanks @ganeshmshetty (#323, #324).

## Image to PPTX

- The profile now defines how page-pixel geometry maps to the SVG canvas, so native text and shapes stay aligned with the base layers when the canvas differs from the source size (f2a20a0f, discussion #272).

## Installation and docs

- `pip install -r requirements.txt` no longer fails with `UnicodeDecodeError` on Chinese Windows (GBK locale) (69634d65, discussion #321).
- README and the positioning docs now name the optional services that send data off the machine: image generation, web image search, URL import and online narration (cc8b722a, discussion #69).

This week's release includes Pyrefly as an optional built-in Python language server, the ability to expand and inspect nested variable values directly in debugger hovers, and DWARF debugging for WebAssembly sources in the JavaScript debugger.

## Features

### AI

- Improved fuzzy searching in agent model and configuration option pickers for Zed Agent and third-party ACP agents, while keeping search preparation off the UI thread. ([#64147](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64147); thanks [JacobNWolf](https://github.com/JacobNWolf))
- Improved OpenCode compatibility when replaying DeepSeek reasoning and disabling thinking for Google models. ([#65922](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65922))
- Improved thinking controls to explain when thinking cannot be disabled at the selected effort level. ([#62480](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/62480))

### Debugger

- Added DWARF debugging to the JavaScript debugger to support debugging WebAssembly sources. ([#65371](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65371); thanks [SGumbles](https://github.com/SGumbles))
- Improved debugger hovers with an expandable, keyboard-accessible variable tree. ([#53198](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/53198); thanks [Tortes](https://github.com/Tortes))

### Languages

- Added Pyrefly as an optional built-in Python language server, available when enabled in the Python `language_servers` setting. ([#44262](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44262); thanks [grievejia](https://github.com/grievejia))

- Improved SQL syntax highlighting in Rust `sql!` string literals. ([#58778](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/58778); thanks [kuskhan](https://github.com/kuskhan))

### Remote Development

- Improved SSH reconnections by starting the resync timeout only after the handshake completes. ([#65457](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65457); thanks [Huliiiiii](https://github.com/Huliiiiii))

### macOS

- Added support for the Display P3 color space on macOS with the `use_display_p3` setting. ([#64394](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64394); thanks [MDalstrom](https://github.com/MDalstrom))

- Fixed discarding unstaged changes in the Git Panel also discarding staged changes. ([#65559](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65559); thanks [stezu](https://github.com/stezu))
- Fixed hangs when restoring agent threads with subagents. ([#65177](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65177))

name: v1.25.2
body:
This week's release includes smaller Zed binaries across macOS, Windows, and Linux, the ability to apply inlay hint text edits by double-clicking, context compaction and session notices for external agents, and new GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, and Claude Opus 5.5 models on Amazon Bedrock.

## Features

### AI

- Added GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, and Claude Opus 5.5 to the Amazon Bedrock provider. ([#64201](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64201), [#64685](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64685); thanks [IbrahimKhan12](https://github.com/IbrahimKhan12) and [alexandergunnarson](https://github.com/alexandergunnarson))
- Enabled session notices and context compaction for external agents using ACP. ([#65414](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65414))

### Git

- Improved the branch picker to make clear that deleting a remote-tracking branch only removes the local ref, and removed the force delete option for remote-tracking branches, since it had no effect. ([#61793](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/61793); thanks [lld4n](https://github.com/lld4n))

### Languages

- Added support for applying inlay hint text edits by double-clicking a hint, or by running `editor: accept inlay hint` with the cursor at the hint. ([#64789](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64789))
- Added HTML syntax highlighting for `svg`, `mathml` and `raw` tagged templates, and CSS syntax highlighting for template literals in `css({ ... })` objects, in JavaScript and TypeScript. ([#65688](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65688))

### Remote Development

- Improved SSH remote connection time by detecting the remote shell, platform, and OS version in one command instead of three, which helps most when connecting from Windows. ([#65065](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65065); thanks [Huliiiiii](https://github.com/Huliiiiii))

### Other

- Added automatic unfolding of folded sections when jumping to a location via go to line, go to definition/declaration/implementation/type definition, symbol navigation, the outline and project symbol pickers, multibuffer location results, and navigation history. ([#65217](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65217); thanks [henne90gen](https://github.com/henne90gen))
- Added an "Open SVG Preview" option to the Project Panel's context menu for SVG files. ([#65539](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65539); thanks [skmanoj322](https://github.com/skmanoj322))
- Added the `tab_switcher.show_file_preview` setting, which controls whether files are previewed in the editor while cycling through the tab switcher (defaults to `true`). ([#56235](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/56235); thanks [sebascadpi](https://github.com/sebascadpi))
- Improved the tab switcher so it no longer changes selection on mouse hover and no longer delays showing its popover; you can still click entries to switch tabs. ([#65546](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65546))
- Improved startup time when restoring hundreds of editor selections. ([#65171](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65171))
- Improved startup time when using custom icon themes. ([#65173](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65173))
- Reduced Zed's binary size by about 33% on macOS, 28% on Windows, and 7% on Linux. ([#65168](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65168))

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a bug where environment variables, including secrets, passed to external agents and MCP servers in remote projects were visible in the local machine's process list. ([#65174](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65174))
- Fixed prompts to external agents being slow to send, or never sending, because of unneeded Git checkpoints. ([#65304](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65304))
- Fixed the remote server failing to start when connecting to a Windows host over SSH. ([#55292](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/55292); thanks [sergio-u](https://github.com/sergio-u))
- Fixed `ctrl-o` and `ctrl-i` in Vim mode not navigating back and forward when a Markdown preview was focused. ([#65299](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65299); thanks [gitKashish](https://github.com/gitKashish))
- Fixed a bug where archiving an agent thread did nothing and kept a CPU core busy when the thread's linked worktree folder had been deleted. ([#65578](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65578))
- Fixed a bug where case conversion and other text transformation commands duplicated the word when multiple cursors were inside it. ([#65291](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65291); thanks [gitKashish](https://github.com/gitKashish))
- Fixed a bug where navigating back skipped a Markdown preview tab after switching to another file. ([#65299](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65299); thanks [gitKashish](https://github.com/gitKashish))
- Fixed a bug where notification sounds could stop playing after an audio output error, and on Linux an audio thread could keep using a full CPU core until Zed restarted. ([#65158](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65158))
- Fixed a bug where the Git Panel's commit editor buttons changed opacity when hovering over empty space. ([#65448](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65448); thanks [shuvroroy](https://github.com/shuvroroy))
- Fixed a bug where the Project Panel's "Open Markdown Preview" option did not appear for files opened on their own (e.g. `zed README.md`). ([#65539](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65539); thanks [skmanoj322](https://github.com/skmanoj322))
- Fixed a bug where the Settings UI sidebar did not highlight the subsection being scrolled through, including the last short subsections of a page. ([#65172](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65172); thanks [mayurathavale18](https://github.com/mayurathavale18))
- Fixed a visual artifact at the corners of scrollable code blocks when hovered. ([#64978](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64978))
- Fixed blurred window backgrounds not blurring on macOS 27. ([#65361](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65361); thanks [biw](https://github.com/biw))
- Fixed edit predictions showing an unlimited allowance and available controls when a team organization with no active subscription was selected. ([#65301](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65301))
- Fixed external agents' first updates in a new thread sometimes being dropped, and agent error output being missing when an agent exited during startup. ([#65339](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65339))
- Fixed extra space between the scrollbar and the header of terminals in the Agent Panel. ([#65358](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65358); thanks [chrisdrackett](https://github.com/chrisdrackett))
- Fixed Gemini models failing with an error after a tool call returned an image. ([#65576](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65576))
- Fixed hover popovers flickering or closing too early on mouse movement with language servers that omit range information. ([#64032](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64032); thanks [daydalek](https://github.com/daydalek))
- Fixed images inside center- or right-aligned HTML blocks rendering left-aligned in Markdown Preview. ([#63166](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/63166); thanks [pray3m](https://github.com/pray3m))
- Fixed OpenAI-compatible edit predictions failing on servers that limit stop sequences to 4. ([#65360](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65360); thanks [mischah](https://github.com/mischah))
- Fixed search not working in the debugger's terminal, opened with `cmd-f` (macOS) or `ctrl-shift-f` (Linux/Windows). ([#56863](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/56863); thanks [iamsushank](https://github.com/iamsushank))
- Fixed text finder queries filled in from the current selection being treated as a regular expression instead of literal text when regex mode was on. ([#65321](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65321); thanks [Syozik](https://github.com/Syozik))
- Fixed the Collab Panel's empty-state styling not matching the Git Panel. ([#65290](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65290); thanks [arondubovszky](https://github.com/arondubovszky))
- Fixed window controls being misaligned in the threads sidebar header when no project is open. ([#65651](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65651))
- Fixed wrapped links in Markdown tables being partially unclickable in Markdown previews and agent responses. ([#65366](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65366); thanks [julian-bruyers](https://github.com/julian-bruyers))

name: openclaw 2026.10.6
body:
## 2026.10.6

### Highlights

- **Patched Node runtime required:** OpenClaw now requires Node 24.22.1+ on the 24 line or 26.12.1+ on the 26 line, which reject TLS chains signed with the compromised certificate keys addressed in the October 2026 Node.js security releases. Docker images ship Node 24.22.1, installers select the patched runtimes, and `openclaw update` refuses with recovery guidance before installing on an older Node instead of breaking the running install. Source builds now pin pnpm 12.15.0. (#179992) Thanks @joshavant.
- **Safer updates and recovery:** package swaps now refuse unsafe service states, Windows and macOS package-manager updates recover from platform-specific failures, and frozen Gateway startup owners can be retired cleanly. (#171101, #170940, #171936, #171678) Thanks @RomneyDa, @homeworld520, @Yolo521-bot, @stop-time, @AntaresGG, and @TommyLei666.
- **Data-preserving migrations and backups:** Doctor and migration paths now refuse malformed or lossy workspace imports, preserve malformed Notes bytes, reject unsafe non-UTF-8 wiki rewrites, keep deeply nested SQLite backups, and retain staging evidence when restore inspection fails. (#172293, #172953, #172742, #174573, #168583, #170867, #172028) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @RomneyDa, @Leon-SK668, @ericcurtin, @Yolo521-bot, @obviyus, and @altaywtf.
- **Reliable delivery across restarts:** queued turns, watched child results, dead-lettered deliveries, and streamed replies now survive recovery without disappearing, duplicating, or producing false missing-answer notices. (#170384, #169489, #169932, #173798) Thanks @RomneyDa, @huyengiang101086-spec, and @Yolo521-bot.
- **Provider and model resilience:** GPT-5.6 tool turns, OpenRouter DeepSeek tool calls, LM Studio overflow recovery, parallel OpenAI reasoning settings, and model retry/fallback budgets now behave consistently. (#176709, #175058, #169189, #169322, #164808) Thanks @RomneyDa, @Linux2010, @ZhimingQ, @xpeng5278-web, and @anyech.
- **Windows and mobile stability:** fresh Windows state stores, Proxy-backed environments, and stored Anthropic credentials no longer block startup, while iOS Talk and chat connectivity recover from first-reply and timeout failures. (#176174, #176194, #174571, #168416, #169912) Thanks @RomneyDa, @tjarrau-dev, @skyzhao1223, @easyteacher, @scalesmart, @masatohoshino, @Takhoffman, and @Solvely-Colin.
- **Agent and tool-call recovery:** unfinished tools now time out visibly, context overflow compacts after steered tool results, malformed calls continue after earlier refusals, large patch hunks avoid argument-limit crashes, and stopped yielded tasks stay stopped. (#172983, #172019, #170615, #174477, #169453) Thanks @RomneyDa, @budzation, @mirasrael, @r3n3x, @freeqaz-openai, and @obviyus.
- **Channel delivery correctness:** WhatsApp retries and stickers, Telegram albums and dual-stack replies, Slack relay recovery, and Discord voice-call replies no longer lose or duplicate messages. (#142434, #164210, #163926, #171564, #173407, #172380) Thanks @ashawwal, @RomneyDa, @andrewwbuilds, @abacha, @Dat1GUI, @brainmonger, @obviyus, and @vincentkoc.
- **Worker and worktree recovery:** hosts reclaim worker capacity after reboot, partial-clone worktrees repair missing objects, and child-result and exec-wake evidence survives Gateway restarts. (#168863, #168864, #169489, #169645) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Changes

- This patch release contains focused reliability fixes only; it does not introduce new user-facing features.

### Fixes

- **State and system-agent recovery:** restore access to agents held by affected upgrades, recover held system-agent databases after schema changes, and preserve live configuration when forensic snapshots fail. (#175007, #176783, #171217) Thanks @RomneyDa, @PennyVibe, and @Yolo521-bot.
- **Windows state and updates:** canonicalize schema ownership across path aliases, serialize Proxy-backed environments before inspection IPC, hide SQLite helper windows during update work, and recognize native Scheduled Task permission failures in every locale. (#176174, #176194, #174969, #178624) Thanks @RomneyDa, @tjarrau-dev, @skyzhao1223, @easyteacher, and @throwingbones.
- **macOS companion execution:** honor long command and approval deadlines across the companion socket, classify late or lost replies without replaying submitted commands, and preserve native permission details. (#172117) Thanks @holgergruenhagen, @RomneyDa, @ylcn91, and @Colton-Harris.
- **Doctor and managed plugins:** repair empty retired-plugin metadata, clear resolved migration warnings, and converge app-managed plugins onto the installed core version. (#173851, #177096, #174257) Thanks @RomneyDa, @fengfan201314-eng, @ScientificProgrammer, @yinx65588-boop, @jj5638521, and @kazuyuki-eguchi.
- **Update diagnostics:** preserve FRV blockers, explain package-journal identity and runtime-retention failures, and avoid cleanup stalls on shared recovery manifests. (#171186, #170385, #169280, #174249) Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @astapenkoav, @council10-kera, and @shoaibulhaque.
- **SQLite correctness:** preserve transaction outcomes when warning handlers throw, settle peer closes after shared-worker refusal, and prevent retired cache generations from taking worker ownership. (#157151, #173813, #172798) Thanks @vincentkoc and @RomneyDa.
- **Reply recovery:** preserve side-question and immediate fallback ordering, avoid repeated or missing answers after streamed delivery, and keep stopped yielded tasks from restarting. (#174869, #169305, #173798, #169453) Thanks @RomneyDa and @freeqaz-openai.
- **Codex and native sessions:** release stalled startup waits and completed subagents after cancellation or cleanup failures, preserve conversations across runtime restarts, keep workspace bindings across reply resets, and settle recovered child binding writes before session readiness. (#168347, #173547, #166368, #160549, #177564) Thanks @RomneyDa, @Kimiyu-186, @alkor2000, @jhgaylor, @vincentkoc, @jjjhenriksen, and @obviyus.
- **Gateway lifecycle:** retain restart custody, avoid stop-time lease deadlocks, recover worker capacity after reboot, and preserve suppressed-channel configuration across reloads. (#172852, #171308, #168863) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **CLI and process diagnostics:** preserve JSON output on Gateway command exits, report resource-disposal and PTY EOF failures, and surface failed diagnostic writes without crashing. (#176795, #173566, #176362, #174622) Thanks @vincentkoc and @RomneyDa.
- **Scheduled follow-ups:** same-conversation follow-ups scheduled from an authorized operator turn keep that operator's current authority when they run, and one-shot continuations can call `next_check` to check back later. (#176422)
- **Media and TTS:** time out slow hosted speech synthesis and report playback cache, probe, and quota failures rather than silently dropping cleanup errors. (#175614, #175634, #174668) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.5..bba7238a1be3a0d4e92c371988f94e81011a06b2 history: 293 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 293 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.
